provenance: WP-S2 (2026-09-24): hand-authored morphological lexicon for La Forge's item bank. Nouns carry gender and plural; adjectives their four forms and position; verbs their present tables (regular -er computed), participle, auxiliary, future stem and deliberate trap stems. Cast and places come from app/prompts/serial/world_bible_paris_v2.json. WP-S5 (2026-09-24): semantic annotations — noun domains (dom), what a place holds (holds) and what happens there (use / at_*), prices, capacities, story objects, adjective domains (kinds), verb aspect (stative, mishap, oneoff, habit), where a verb happens (at), how long (dur), part of day.
